name: Sega Mega-CD
description: A CD-ROM add-on for the Mega Drive, released as the Sega CD in North America. It added a second, faster 68000, scaling and rotation hardware and CD audio, and became known for full-motion video games like Night Trap as well as Sonic CD.

specs.memory: 512 KB program RAM + 256 KB word RAM + 64 KB PCM RAM

curiosities: Night Trap was among the games cited in the 1993 US congressional hearings on video game violence.
Sonic CD lets players time travel between past, present and future versions of each zone.
It could also play audio CDs and CD+G discs.
Front-loading and top-loading models were made, as well as all-in-one units such as JVC's Wondermega.
story: Sega's CD add-on for the Mega Drive launched in Japan in December 1991, adding a CD drive, a second processor and sprite scaling.
Full-motion video games such as Night Trap became famous, while Sonic CD, Snatcher and Lunar showed what it could do best.
It sold about 2.2 million units and prepared Sega for CD consoles.
